title: SPECIAL REVIEW PROVISIONS
previewText:
The provisions of this Section shall apply to all developments, enlargements or site alterations located within a Special Natural Area District.

blocks.plainText: The provisions of this Section shall apply to all developments, enlargements or site alterations located within a Special Natural Area District.

blocks.html: Prior to the issuance by the Department of Buildings of any permit for a development, enlargement or site alteration within a Special Natural Area District, the City Planning Commission shall certify to the Department of Buildings that the development, enlargement or site alteration is approved pursuant to Sections 105-41 (Certification), 105-42 (Authorizations to Alter Natural Features), 105-43 (Authorizations to Modify Bulk, Parking, Grading and Private Roads Regulations) or 105-44 (Special Permit), inclusive.
blocks.plainText: Prior to the issuance by the Department of Buildings of any permit for a development, enlargement or site alteration within a Special Natural Area District, the City Planning Commission shall certify to the Department of Buildings that the development, enlargement or site alteration is approved pursuant to Sections 105-41 (Certification), 105-42 (Authorizations to Alter Natural Features), 105-43 (Authorizations to Modify Bulk, Parking, Grading and Private Roads Regulations) or 105-44 (Special Permit), inclusive.

blocks.html: The provisions of Article VII, Chapter 8 (Special Regulations Applying to Large-scale Residential Developments), shall apply to a large-scale residential development, as modified by the provisions of Section 105-701 (Applicability of large-scale residential development regulations).
